summary: One record per disposition event or protocol milestone per subject: informed consent, randomisation, completion or discontinuation for each epoch.

DSTERM.tip: The reason or event as collected, e.g. "Subject moved away".

DSDECOD.tip: Standard term: for disposition events from the NCOMPLT codelist (e.g. "COMPLETED", "ADVERSE EVENT", "WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT"), for milestones from PROTMLST (e.g. "INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED", "RANDOMIZED").

DSSTDTC.tip: Date of the event. The informed consent record's date should equal DM.RFICDTC.

EPOCH.tip: For disposition events, the epoch being completed or left, e.g. "TREATMENT".
